definitions.explanation: A book that gathers several short stories, usually by a single author. May also refer to a collection of short films or other brief works.

examples.japanese: この{作家|さっか}の{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought this author's short story collection.

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}を1{話|わ}ずつ{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: I read one story from a short story collection each night before bed.

examples.japanese: デビュー{作|さく}は{長編|ちょうへん}ではなく{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}だった。
examples.english: Their debut work was not a novel but a short story collection.

notes:
Compound of {短編|たんぺん} (short piece) + {集|しゅう} (collection). Each story in such a volume is called a {短編|たんぺん} or {短編|たんぺん}{小説|しょうせつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短編集|たんぺんしゅう}を{読|よ}む: to read a short story collection
- {短編集|たんぺんしゅう}を{出|だ}す: to publish a short story collection
- ミステリー{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}: mystery short story collection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {長編|ちょうへん}{小説|しょうせつ}: novel; long-form work — antonym
- {中編|ちゅうへん}: novella — between short story and novel in length
- アンソロジー: anthology — loanword, often used for multi-author collections
- {作品集|さくひんしゅう}: works collection — broader, can include any genre or medium
